slots.title: Share image: default (also the home page)
where: every page without its own share image
slots.brief: The NASFAQ share card. Dark ink ground (#0a0c11) with a wall of glowing ticker boards receding to the right: rising candlestick bars and sparklines in hololive blue (#3fb8f5), a few small up/down arrow tiles, halftone bloom around the brightest board. Lower right: three or four generic chibi-proportioned fans in hoodies with glowsticks and phones, cheering at the boards, seen from behind. The left 55% is calm, dark and nearly empty: the NASFAQ wordmark and the line 'Every hololive talent is a stock' are composited there by the pipeline. Flat graphic shapes, crisp edges, no gradients that band.
slots.notes: Keep everything important inside the centre 1080×566 (platforms crop the edges). No text or logos in the generated art; the wordmark is added afterwards. Not wired yet: hook it in app/layout.tsx as metadata.openGraph.images and metadata.twitter.images (card: summary_large_image) once the file is served at /art/og/default.png, and set metadata.metadataBase to the public origin so the URL is absolute.

slots.title: 404: off the chart
slots.brief: A single glowing blue price line runs across a dark trading-board grid and then simply walks off the right edge of the board into black, like a road that ends at a cliff. A small generic chibi fan (hoodie, lanyard, no identifying features) stands at the broken end holding a flashlight, peering over the edge. A few loose grid tiles float down into the dark. Dark ink ground (#0a0c11), hololive blue (#3fb8f5) line and highlights, flat shapes with halftone shading.
slots.notes: Sits centred above the '404 / Off the chart' copy, about 560px wide on desktop and full width on phones. Feather all four edges into #0a0c11 so it floats on the page. No numbers or text.

slots.title: Error page: something broke
slots.brief: A trading terminal monitor on a desk with its screen glitched into blue scanlines and one big blank error window, sparks popping from the back where two fat cables have come unplugged. A generic chibi fan stands beside it holding one cable end in each hand, puzzled, a sweat drop over its head. Dark ink ground (#0a0c11), hololive blue (#3fb8f5) glow, a touch of warning amber (#f5b83f) on the sparks, flat shapes with halftone shading.
slots.notes: Shown above a 'Something broke' message with a retry button, ~520px wide. Feather the edges into #0a0c11. No text on the screen.

slots.title: Sign in / register: the floor at the opening bell
slots.brief: An invitation onto the floor: looking down a row of trader desks at the opening bell, monitors lighting up in hololive blue (#3fb8f5) one after another, a big ticker board at the far end full of up-arrows, confetti-like order slips in the air. In the foreground on the nearest desk, a fresh welcome kit: a banded stack of play-money bills with a blue diamond stamp, a blank lanyard badge and a steaming mug. Dark ink ground (#0a0c11), flat shapes, halftone light.
slots.notes: Top of the pitch panel next to the form, about 380px wide (full width on phones). A talent chibi (top mover) is layered over the top-right corner, so keep that quarter calm. The heading sits directly below the image.

slots.title: Verify email: link in flight
slots.brief: A sealed envelope with a hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) wax seal shaped like a diamond, flying left to right with flat speed lines and a couple of small sparkles. Flat graphic shapes, halftone shading, white paper with cool grey shadows.
slots.notes: Rendered at 96px (72px on phones), top right of the verify card. Transparent background; keep the silhouette readable small.

slots.title: Verify email: you're in
slots.brief: The same envelope torn open, a glowing hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) trader pass (a blank lanyard badge with a diamond) shooting up out of it, confetti and little stars bursting around. Flat graphic shapes, halftone shading, celebratory.
slots.notes: Same size and position as site.verify-pending; the three verify spots should read as a set.

slots.title: Verify email: bad link
slots.brief: The envelope crumpled, its diamond wax seal cracked in two, a tiny grey rain cloud dripping on it. Muted greys with one red (#ff4460) accent on the cracked seal. Flat graphic shapes, halftone shading.
slots.notes: Same size and position as site.verify-pending.

slots.title: Medal: 1st place
slots.brief: A gold medal seen straight on: a chunky coin with a raised diamond emblem in the centre and a small up-arrow notch at the top, hanging from a short hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) ribbon. Flat graphic shapes with a single sharp specular highlight and halftone shading on the rim.
slots.notes: Part of a set of three (gold, silver, bronze) that must match in shape and lighting; only the metal changes. Shown at 36–44px in the corner of each podium step, so no fine detail and no numerals. Reusable anywhere a top-three shows up (Ticker Tap weekly board, forecasters).
